The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 9-10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Let (X, ∆) be a normal compact Kähler lc pair with rational boundary and rational Cartier adjoint J. Let p : Y → X be a log resolution, and put BY = p−1 ∗ ∆ + X E exceptional E. 9 If p∗J is pseudo-effective and the conclusion of Definition 2.1 holds for (Y, BY ), then there is a smooth compact Kähler modification r : V → X with an actual rational line identity r∗ J ∼Q P + R, P semiample, R = N(r∗ J) ≥ 0, where R is a rational divisor. If J is analytically nef, it is semiample on X.
